name: hsm_smvm_wrq_t_r1
purpose: H-SM 2026-10-16: hardened SM result -> VM writer smw_<q>, ONE master for the 4 instances (option A wrapper: folded ot_static_cmd_target MODE 1 command calendar CW 26 + 128x256 table, tgt strap; quad strap replaces parameter QUAD). Pin-bound: W rv/rrow/rdata 2,152, E wq 2,248 at ~6 pins/um -> 388.8 um faces; width 142.56 for the 94.8 um table macro with >= 20 um channels; N F20 bus + straps + status. ~11.3k writer flops + collar. The RTL registers every input at its pin and every output is a flop; pin_reg_split gives each replicated wq data pin its own launch flop: 0 added edges (calendar fire edge unchanged; rv(t) -> wq slot0 at t+3). rst_n lands on one local reset-release flop.
